notes: The noun 'το πρωινό' means 'breakfast', whereas 'το πρωί' is the normal word for 'morning'.
Comes from the adjective 'πρωινός, -ή, -ό' (morning, early), as in 'πρωινή βόλτα' (morning walk).

faults.quote: (time) The early part of the day.
